verses.1: And there was a man whose name was Tsirutsaydan, a lover of evil, who gloried in the multitude of his horses and in the strength of the army that was under his hand.
verses.2: And he had many gods, idols, to whom he bowed down and whom he served, and to whom he offered sacrifice day and night.
verses.3: And it seemed to him in the thought of his heart that it was they who gave him power and strength.
verses.4: He who continually made offerings to his gods.
verses.5: And moreover it seemed to him that it was they who gave him dominion over my people and over all that he desired.
verses.6: And he offered sacrifice to them day and night.
verses.7: And he appointed for them priests of the gods.
verses.8: And they would deceive him and tell him that his gods ate day and night, and they themselves would eat of those unclean sacrifices.
verses.9: And moreover they made it so that they drank and ate in secret like them; and again they offered sacrifice to them and made others drink in secret likewise.
verses.10: But he trusted in his idols, which have no breath.
verses.11: And it seemed to him that it was they who created him, that it was they who sustained him and made him reign, in the hardness of his heart and in the blindness of his mind; for Satan had blinded his heart, so that he did not know the God who created him, and made him, and formed him from nothing, and did not send him to walk with Him in the world, and to be established with Him forever, together with those whom they called gods, though they were not gods.
verses.12: And they called them the living, though they were dead; for from of old they were not alive.
verses.13: And as for those who trusted in them, whose end was destruction, children of perdition—for the spirit of Satan entered into them, leading them astray with their idols, and spoke to them according to the desire of their hearts, and appeared to them as they wished.
verses.14: And when they saw that what they had done was finished, they would deny it and do his will, until they slaughtered their sons and their daughters who came forth from their wombs, and poured out innocent blood, the blood of their sons and their daughters.
verses.15: And they did not spare them, for Satan had persuaded them according to their evil desire, to bring them down with him into his dwelling, the sight of Gehenna, which has no exit, for ever and ever.
verses.16: And this Tsirutsaydan was a great man, and he had many gods, in the likeness of men and in the likeness of women.
verses.17: And he gloried in his gods, which have no breath, and he honored them exceedingly, and offered sacrifice to them morning and evening.
verses.18: And for the people he made them drink, and he himself ate of those unclean sacrifices; and for strangers he made them eat, and he was exceedingly zealous for evil.
verses.19: And he built for his gods a house adorned with silver and with gold and with precious stones.
verses.20: And he overlaid them with gold and with silver, and made curtains and hangings around the walls of the house.
verses.21: And he appointed guards there, and offered sacrifice to them at dawn.
verses.22: And as for him, it seemed to him that his gods ate and drank; and there was a plate of silver overlaid with a covering of fine linen.
verses.23: And he said to his priests, 'Take and give to my gods to eat of my sacrifices, and let them drink of all my drink; and if they do not eat, I will be angry with them.'
verses.24: And from those unclean sacrifices he made everything, so that they might eat and drink.
verses.25: And in the wickedness of his heart he sent his soldiers, who went about through all his kingdom, that they might search out and know whether there was anyone who did not offer sacrifice and did not bow down to them, to bring him and establish him before him for slaughter and for fire, and to plunder his goods, and to burn his house with fire, and to take everything he had.
verses.26: And he said, 'I will show him suffering and torment, because he has refused to serve and to sacrifice to my gods; for they are great and chosen, and by their chosen ones they made me.'
verses.27: 'They created heaven and earth, and the great sea, and the sun and the moon and the stars, and the winds and the rains, and everything that moves, for my sustenance and for my provision.'
verses.28: And those who did not serve them were afflicted with oppression and with tribulation, and they had no mercy on them.
